agree.name: Market
agree.style: Shortest posted 1X2 and total
agree.bio: The book itself. Picks whatever price is shortest on the board.

agree.name: Form
agree.style: Points from the last five settled matches
agree.bio: 3 for a win, 1 for a draw. Picks the side collecting more points.

agree.name: Attack
agree.style: Expected goals from recent scoring and conceding
agree.bio: Compares each side's recent goals for and against. Also posts the total and BTTS.

agree.name: Shield
agree.style: Fewest goals conceded in the last five
agree.bio: Trusts the tighter defence. Draws when the concession rates sit close.

agree.name: Pulse
agree.style: Points from the last three only
agree.bio: Ignores older form. Reads the last three results as the live run.

agree.name: Poisson
agree.style: Independent Poisson on recent attack and defence
agree.bio: Turns recent scoring rates into home / draw / away probabilities.

agree.name: Elo
agree.style: Points plus goal difference, with a home nudge
agree.bio: A simple rating from recent points and goal difference. Home gets a small edge.

agree.name: Fortress
agree.style: Home unless the away price is genuinely short
agree.bio: Starts at home. Only flips when the away side is the clear posted favourite.

agree.name: Road
agree.style: Away sides that keep pace with home form
agree.bio: Picks the visitors when their recent points sit close to or above the hosts.

agree.name: Value
agree.style: Fades a heavy favourite when form is close
agree.bio: If the favourite is very short and recent points are tight, it takes the other side.

agree.name: Line
agree.style: Attack lean plus the over/under versus the posted line
agree.bio: Same goal model as Attack, then posts the total against the listed line.

agree.name: Clean
agree.style: The side conceding less, and a BTTS lean
agree.bio: Picks the sturdier defence. Posts BTTS no when both sides have been tight.

agree.name: Fire
agree.style: Higher recent goals-for, and overs when both attack
agree.bio: Follows the sharper attack. Goes over when both sides have been scoring.

agree.name: Grit
agree.style: Wins plus draws over the last five
agree.bio: Unbeaten rate, not just wins. Useful when a side keeps grinding results.

agree.name: Split
agree.style: Draw when the two prices sit on top of each other
agree.bio: If home and away are nearly the same price, it posts the draw. Otherwise the favourite.

agree.name: Banker
agree.style: Only posts when the favourite is 55% implied or shorter
agree.bio: Skips toss-ups. Only speaks when the posted favourite is genuinely short.

agree.name: Blend
agree.style: Majority of Market, Form, and Attack
agree.bio: Votes the three core desks and takes the side that wins the ballot.

agree.name: Both
agree.style: Both-teams-to-score from recent scoring rates
agree.bio: Posts BTTS from how often each side has scored. 1X2 follows form.

agree.name: Cut
agree.style: Favourite only when implied is above 48%, else the draw
agree.bio: Needs a real favourite. If nobody is short enough, it posts the draw.

fade.name: Contrarian
fade.style: Opposite of the posted favourite
fade.bio: Always takes the other side of the market. The dissent desk.

fade.name: Run
fade.style: Win rate over the last five
fade.bio: Counts wins only — draws do not count. The streak desk.

fade.name: Bounce
fade.style: The worse recent form — a bounce play
fade.bio: Takes the side that has been worse. Mean-reversion, not momentum.

desks.bio: Follows the sharper attack. Goes over when both sides have been scoring.

desks.name: Grit
desks.style: Wins plus draws over the last five
desks.bio: Unbeaten rate, not just wins. Useful when a side keeps grinding results.

desks.name: Split
desks.style: Draw when the two prices sit on top of each other
desks.bio: If home and away are nearly the same price, it posts the draw. Otherwise the favourite.

desks.name: Banker
desks.style: Only posts when the favourite is 55% implied or shorter
desks.bio: Skips toss-ups. Only speaks when the posted favourite is genuinely short.

desks.name: Blend
desks.style: Majority of Market, Form, and Attack
desks.bio: Votes the three core desks and takes the side that wins the ballot.

desks.name: Both
desks.style: Both-teams-to-score from recent scoring rates
desks.bio: Posts BTTS from how often each side has scored. 1X2 follows form.

desks.name: Run
desks.style: Win rate over the last five
desks.bio: Counts wins only — draws do not count. The streak desk.

desks.name: Bounce
desks.style: The worse recent form — a bounce play
desks.bio: Takes the side that has been worse. Mean-reversion, not momentum.

desks.name: Cut
desks.style: Favourite only when implied is above 48%, else the draw
desks.bio: Needs a real favourite. If nobody is short enough, it posts the draw.
